text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE finished photographic storyboard contact sheet, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows of twelve equally sized portrait frames, read left to right and top to bottom. Overall portrait 3:4 canvas1086x1448, clean thin cream gutters and tiny panel numbers01-12 only. Every frame is a real warm natural lifestyle photograph, genuine fur and textiles, soft cream/ivory and pale oak surroundings, gentle daylight indoors and coherent warm evening light when specified. The same compact golden-orange shorthaired tabby kitten in every panel, very round plush cheeks, ivory muzzle/chin/chest, huge round dark-olive eyes and black pupils, tiny pink nose, fine white whiskers and delicate tabby stripes; real rounded feline paws, no extra limbs, human fingers on cat or floating tools. Home garment when indicated: tiny near-square cream linen chest bib nested between forelegs, blue fish pocket applique, bib width around half chest, bottom above belly with legs and belly fur exposed. Forelegs occlude bib side edges. Narrow curved neck loop and separate lower chest band with a tiny back knot and short ties; no crossed back harness. Exterior outfit A when specified: yellow short-sleeve tee, blue denim bib overalls, tan wooden buttons and red knitted bow. Outfit B: white sailor cap with plain navy band, pale-blue short-sleeve shirt with navy square sailor collar and two white stripes, white front buttons and plain navy cat trousers with a tail opening; no necktie or hat emblem. Small white pleated chef toque only in cooking scenes where indicated. Cleaning garment only where specified: plain pale-blue round-neck short smock with elastic sleeve cuffs, front opening, no pockets, navy sailor collar or layered home bib. Owner camera POV whenever described, only the explicitly needed zero to two anatomically connected hands with powder-blue white-piped pajama cuffs enter from camera-bottom; no visible owner face, hair, torso, reflection or detached third arm. In solo shopping, cooking and household chores no helping human hands; supermarket clerk is a separate adult NPC only in specified frames. One frozen action per frame, alternatives are separate frames, not repeated cats or mixed branch outcomes. English phone UI when indicated, no dialogue captions, story title, balloons or control buttons. The following Chinese shot directions are production instructions, never render them as captions. Preserve the depicted wardrobe and pose separately for each numbered frame.

Panel01: 收袜子后的半个舞步 — 围裙已自行脱下，收袜后回想柯基，半个舞步便困了。 Composition: Bare kitten at low drying rack with paired dry socks and basket, owner hands take large towel from upper rail.
Panel02: 空篮子也好重 — 独自把空篮子推回，速度慢下来。 Composition: Kitten slowly pushing empty low laundry basket toward wardrobe, warm hall light, posture tired but comfortable.
Panel03: 等主人洗漱 — 咪等主人画外洗漱，只做一次有因哈欠。 Composition: Kitten on mat outside softly lit bathroom door, mouth closed listening, no woman face visible.
Panel04: 明天准备好了 — 主人第一视角确认明天闹钟与勿扰。 Composition: POV blue pajama sleeves setting phone on nightstand, calendar/alarm screen blank for post, a few loose ash-blonde hair strands.
Panel05: 拖鞋一次摆对 — 猫自己把拖鞋摆正，回扣早晨。 Composition: Downward owner POV near bed: kitten next to correctly paired cream slippers, clean apron now hanging off in background.
Panel06: 困了还要照顾你 — 咪面对主人视点问还要什么，问完合嘴。 Composition: Kitten at ivory duvet edge with forehead just resting on quilt, front paws support body, warm bedside lamp.
Panel07: 张开双手 — I11-A：第一视角两手托住猫，身体有支撑。 Composition: Owner POV open blue-sleeved arms beside kitten standing on bed step, kitten begins to place forepaw on sleeve.
Panel08: 怀里找到位置 — I11-A：真正俯视怀里的猫，不拍主人侧脸或头发。 Composition: POV kitten curled securely in blue-pajama lap, one human hand supports flank, tail over duvet edge, sleepy closed mouth.
Panel09: 留一个被窝 — I11-B：猫主动走向主人掀开的被窝。 Composition: POV owner hand lifts light quilt corner beside kitten, open sleeping space next to blue sleeve.
Panel10: 爪子搭着手 — I11-B：一只猫爪搭在主人手背。 Composition: POV sleepy kitten beside owner under light quilt, head and both front paws uncovered, one paw on human hand back.
Panel11: 照片留在手机里 — 仅photo=true回看午餐同一白厨师帽＋蓝鱼围裙照片；否则普通锁屏。 Composition: POV phone on bedside table with small chef-cat photo thumbnail, dim room; for no-photo route phone is plain lock screen.
Panel12: 晚安我的小宝 — 主人俯视安静入睡的小猫，只有手、被子与猫，无主人第三人称形象。 Composition: Close owner POV sleeping golden kitten beside powder-blue sleeve under dim warm lamp, naturally closed mouth, front paw relaxed.
reproduction_note: 独立文生图提示词根据已确认成图及当前镜头索引整理；实际原图曾使用身份参考与局部返修，仅文字未验证近乎一致。原始生成提示词、真实生成日期和审图备注另行保留。
